Nina (partner): Hey team — onboarding for Medrio SI hit a blocker during marketplace install. Images fail verification and installer aborts. Need quick help.
Priya (eng): What error do you see from the installer?
Nina (partner): The agent logs show attestation callback timeout and then 401 on registry pull.
Nina (partner): ```
2024-11-04T09:03:12Z ERROR attestation: callback failed: dial tcp 10.0.0.1:9001: connect: connection refused
2024-11-04T09:03:20Z ERROR registry: pull failed: 401 Unauthorized
```
Tom (arch): Does your tenant block outbound ephemeral ports? Attestation uses a callback port range by default.
Nina (partner): They block all outbound except 80/443 and a narrow set. Our installer assumes callback to 9001.
Eli (sre): If the attestation callback can't reach our endpoint, token exchange fails and registry rejects the pull. Two short-term options: 1) open 9001 from installer subnet, or 2) enable single-port attestation (callback over 443) on marketplace.
Ravi (sales): Customer prefers not to change firewall. Can we do option 2 quickly?
Priya (eng): We have a toggle for single-port mode in marketplace but it's gated and requires a small config rollout. I can prepare the toggle and a canary deploy now if SRE signs off.
Eli (sre): I'll validate it's safe. Also checking certs — saw a TLS cert on attestation service close to expiry in one region last week. If certs are mismatched that could also cause 401s.
Nina (partner): Logs earlier showed TLS handshake errors intermittently.
Priya (eng): Ok plan: Eli validates cert chain and enables the toggle in canary; I'll push the config to the marketplace canary for this partner only. If it passes, we roll to their org.
Eli (sre): Creating incident INC-2810 for tracking. deploy-bot: Incident INC-2810 created by Eli (sre) — P1.
deploy-bot: Notifying @oncall.
Ravi (sales): I'll notify Medrio that we're working on a fix and ask them to standby for a 30m maintenance window.
Tom (arch): Longer-term: we'll add attestation single-port to SI onboarding docs and allow partners to opt in during provisioning. Also propose a feature request to make the callback host configurable to avoid firewall changes.
Priya (eng): PR ready: https://git.redwood.ai/marketplace/pulls/355 — single-port attestation toggle + tests.
Eli (sre): Certs look good now after a quick re-upload in eu-west1. Pushing canary config to marketplace for Medrio. Monitoring image acceptance events.
Nina (partner): Confirmed installer progressed past verification after the toggle and canary. All good from our side.
Ravi (sales): Customer accepts post-upgrade schedule. They asked for a note in the onboarding checklist about ports and cert prechecks.
Tom (arch): Action items: Priya to merge PR and coordinate rollout, Eli to validate certs across regions and update runbook, Ravi to update customer comms, Nina to close out after verification.
Priya (eng): Will merge after 10m smoke test.
Eli (sre): Monitoring for 1h post-merge and will signal rollback if errors spike.
Nina (partner): Thanks everyone — saved the cutover. Please add the port note to the SI docs. :rocket:
